headline: Removed the superintendent's power to make minor changes to opening and closing times, and tabled a security policy.
summary: The superintendent may ask the district attorney whether the Family and Student Handbook covers teen dating violence. Members approved a two-thirds vote requirement for changing facility names and kept policy IB, Academic Freedom, as written. The chair will draft a policy on how subcommittees run meetings.
decisions: Approved unanimously letting the superintendent ask the attorney to review teen dating violence coverage.
Approved 4-0 a draft policy on subcommittee governance practices, to be created by the chair.
Approved 4-0 the minutes of the 6.25.26 Policy and Governance meeting.
Approved 4-0 keeping policy IB, Academic Freedom, as it reads now.
Withdrew the motion to approve policy ID, School Day, with no change.
Approved 4-0 removing the superintendent's authority to make minor changes to school opening and closing times from policy ID.
Approved 4-0 policy BEDB, agenda format, as shown on the agenda.
Tabled policy EHAA, district security relating to technology, 4-0.
Approved 4-0 adding a two-thirds school committee vote to change a facility's name in policy FF.
